strengths: The recurring job is concrete enough to anchor the package.
intent_confidence.anchor_sentence: Turn a product description, public product URL, or product images into a sourced public-market research brief and, after platform selection, a reviewable listing and asset pack. Primary output: A one-page conclusion, comparable product links, observed price range with source/time/market context, public selling-point patterns, risks, platform copy, and image-size or generation brief.. Exclusions: Bulk crawling or scraping, Login-only or protected-page access, Automatic marketplace publishing, Fake reviews, invented product facts, or unsupported claims, Transaction-price, sales, keyword-volume, or ranking guarantees.
intent_confidence.recommended_action: Intent is clear enough to package the first routeable version.

context.job: Turn a product description, public product URL, or product images into a sourced public-market research brief and, after platform selection, a reviewable listing and asset pack.
real_inputs: Optional target platform, region, language, brand voice, and image-generation request
context.primary_output: A one-page conclusion, comparable product links, observed price range with source/time/market context, public selling-point patterns, risks, platform copy, and image-size or generation brief.
context.description: Use when a user provides an ecommerce product description, public product URL, or product images and wants public-market research, observed price ranges, comparable product links, platform-specific listing copy, or optional image-generation briefs. Use public search results and user-provided materials only. Do not crawl or scrape in bulk, access login-only or protected pages, publish listings, invent product facts, or guarantee sales.
exclusions: Fake reviews, invented product facts, or unsupported claims
Transaction-price, sales, keyword-volume, or ranking guarantees
constraints: Public search providers are optional and user-configured.
No provider auto-install and no API-key collection in chat.
Every price and competitor claim records source, query, time, market, and observation basis.
Generated images must preserve the real product and require human review before publishing.
standards: A first useful result should not require a structured product-facts form.
Unsupported claims are marked pending confirmation instead of being guessed.
Platform copy and image generation wait for the user's platform and tool choice.

frontmatter.name: ai-ecommerce-workflow
frontmatter.description: Use when a user provides an ecommerce product description, public product URL, or product images and wants public-market research, observed price ranges, comparable product links, platform-specific listing copy, or optional image-generation briefs. Use public search results and user-provided materials only. Do not crawl or scrape in bulk, access login-only or protected pages, publish listings, invent product facts, or guarantee sales.

interface.display_name: AI 电商公开市场研究与素材包
interface.short_description: 给描述、链接或产品图，先查公开同类和页面价格，再做平台文案与图片规格。
interface.default_prompt: 研究这个商品的公开同类、页面观察价格和用户痛点；先给一页结论，需要时再按目标平台生成文案与图片规格。
